issues: §2.4 lists "Scope: fspt-r" under OAuth 2.0, but Yahoo's guide documents no scope parameter for request_auth — https://developer.yahoo.com/oauth2/guide/flows_authcode/ HTTP 200, "Table 1 Request Authorization URL": client_id, redirect_uri, response_type, state, language; Step 1 has scopes chosen on the app project — options: (a) reword §2.4: fspt-r ("Fantasy Sports: Read") is the API permission to tick when creating the app, and the authorize URL sends no scope (what the probe does); (b) also send scope=fspt-r (undocumented; Yahoo may ignore or reject it).

Yahoo items A–M are unverified; state: awaiting Yahoo approval (YAHOO_CLIENT_ID / YAHOO_CLIENT_SECRET blank) — https://fantasysports.yahooapis.com/fantasy/v2/game/nfl?format=json without credentials: HTTP 401 — even after approval this probe checks OAuth and the game key only; the A–M league checks are Phase 5 work — options: (a) write the Yahoo A–M checks together with the Phase 5 adapter (behind FEATURE_YAHOO); (b) extend probe-yahoo with them as soon as approval lands, before Phase 5.
decisions: Yahoo OAuth plan once YAHOO_CLIENT_ID / YAHOO_CLIENT_SECRET exist: 3-legged OAuth needs a browser and an HTTPS redirect, https://localhost:3000/api/auth/yahoo/callback (served by `npm run dev -- --experimental-https` once the Phase 5 route exists). Until then the probe does the browser-free steps: it writes the authorize URL to .cache\yahoo-oauth\authorize-url.txt (git-ignored; not printed because it contains the client ID), takes the code Parker copies from the redirect via YAHOO_AUTH_CODE, exchanges it once (no retries: codes are single-use) and writes YAHOO_REFRESH_TOKEN straight into .env.local without printing it. Later runs use the stored refresh token for a 1-hour access token, then look up the current NFL game key with game/nfl (never hardcoded): 200 = access is live, 403 = not enabled yet (probe once a day).

Scope of this probe after approval: it verifies OAuth (consent → code → refresh token) and the current NFL game key only, and does not check items A–M. The Yahoo league checklist (league list via users;use_login=1/games;game_keys={game_key}/leagues, then league settings, teams/roster, standings, scoreboard;week={n}, transactions and players;status=A, with the Redactor registering team names, manager nicknames, guids, emails and image URLs) is Phase 5 work and still has to be written.

The authorize URL sends only the parameters Yahoo's guide documents for request_auth (client_id, redirect_uri, response_type, state, language; DOCS.oauthGuide): no scope parameter. fspt-r ("Fantasy Sports: Read") is the API permission chosen when the app is created.

Added YAHOO_AUTH_CODE and YAHOO_REFRESH_TOKEN for the manual OAuth steps; they are not in CLAUDE.md §0.5's variable list. In scripts/lib/env.ts (so every output scrubber hides them): both; in .env.example: both. The code is single-use; the refresh token is written into .env.local by the probe and never printed.
